recent_items.summary: Memory enables language agents to carry useful distinctions from past experience into future decisions. Its value depends on which distinctions survive, whether a bounded agent can use them, and what can be recovered or revised as demands evolve. We develop a decision-theoretic framework that follows this value from raw history through persistent state, operational use, and costly recovery and revision. Original and retained value are expressed in units of avoided task loss; risk-cost frontiers
recent_items.title: The Value of Memory in Language Agents

recent_items.summary: Many LLM agents maintain external persistent memory and derive additional state from past interactions, such as summaries. We introduce AfterDeleteBench, a controlled behavioral audit for this failure mode in fixed-weight LLM agents. recent_items.title: AfterDeleteBench: Auditing Post-Deletion Information Persistence in LLM Agents

recent_items.summary: NovaFabric is self-hosted, open-source replay and evidence infrastructure for AI agents and agentic systems. recent_items.summary: EnzyPair is a benchmark dataset for evaluating enzyme-function similarity at low sequence identity. It contains 1,664 same-EC4 protein pairs and 4,992 structure-matched different-EC4 controls involving 2,465 proteins. The release includes protein sequences, EC annotations, TM-align measurements, residue alignments, exclusion records, source provenance and software versions.
recent_items.title: EnzyPair: a dataset of same-function enzyme pairs with structure-matched controls at low sequence identity

recent_items.summary: Detailed image captioning is usually framed as an amount problem: a model should mention more visual facts while avoiding hallucination. However, autoregressive VLMs generate captions as ordered sequences, and later generations may be produced under weaker or noisier visual grounding.
